verdict.rationale: dlt documents a local DuckDB destination (`pip install "dlt[duckdb]"`) and tutorials that run pipelines into DuckDB on a laptop. You can then inspect the results with `pipeline.dataset()`. The docs also say you can switch destinations without changing pipeline code, which supports promoting a local run to production. missing for 10: explicit testing guidance (unit and integration tests, dev/prod config profiles), independent hands-on corroboration of the local-to-production workflow.
